value.message: Fire is the fire state and cannot also run a script.
Engine Abort is an abort state and cannot run a script — an abort must reach the valves immediately, never behind an interpreter.
Armed: script file "../escape.script" must be a bare <name>.script filename (letters, digits, _ and - only). A path here is refused rather than sanitised.
Fuel Fill runs a script but has no timeout. An unbounded script has no safe degraded mode, so the sequencer will refuse to make this state enterable.
Ox Fill: script timeout 600001 ms is above the 600000 ms ceiling — a typo must not arm a valve-open window measured in hours.
GN2 Low Press runs a script but has no end-of-script target — where it lands when the script runs off its end must be stated, not defaulted.
GN2 Low Vent: timeout target "Nowhere" is not in the state list.
Fuel Press is both the flow-test state and a scripted state. The characterization hold and the script would both own its timer.
